intro.background: 教玩具外贸合同关键条款：T/T电汇（30%定金+70%见提单副本）、L/C即期信用证、尾款、质保金（5%质保一年）、包装条款、唛头、违约责任。项目制通常30/70，大项目可能分3期。
intro.desc: 掌握付款方式和合同条款的英语表达。

oneLiner.en: Payment terms are not just money — they define trust, risk and commitment between you and the client.
oneLiner.cn: 付款方式不只是钱——它定义你和客户之间的信任、风险和承诺。

vocab.ex: For large projects, L/C at sight is preferred.
vocab.exCn: 大项目我们接受即期信用证。

vocab.ex: The balance is paid against B/L copy.
We send the B/L copy after shipment.
vocab.exCn: 发货后我们发提单副本。
质量保证涵盖生产缺陷。

vocab.ex: The penalty clause covers late delivery.
vocab.exCn: 违约条款涵盖延迟交货。

mistakes.right: We require 30 percent T/T deposit to start production, and 70 percent balance against B/L copy before shipment.
mistakes.cn: 错误：说收到再付。要明确定金尾款结构。

basic.en: The balance is paid against B/L copy.
For large orders, L/C at sight is acceptable.
basic.cn: 大订单可接受即期信用证。

basic.en: The penalty clause covers late delivery.
basic.cn: 违约条款涵盖延迟交货。

advanced.en: Our standard terms are 30 percent T/T deposit upon order confirmation, and 70 percent balance against B/L copy before shipment. For projects over USD 200,000, L/C at sight is also acceptable.
advanced.cn: 我们标准条款是：订单确认后30%电汇定金，发货前见提单副本付70%尾款。20万美金以上项目也可接受即期信用证。

advanced.en: We provide a 2-year warranty covering manufacturing defects. A 5 percent quality retention may be held back for 12 months after installation for large projects.
advanced.cn: 我们提供2年质保涵盖生产缺陷。大项目可保留5%质保金，安装后12个月支付。

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: What are your payment terms? We prefer L/C at sight for this project.
lines.cn: 你们付款方式是什么？这个项目我们偏好即期信用证。

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: We accept both T/T and L/C at sight. For this 200,000 USD project, L/C at sight works well. We require 30 percent deposit or 100 percent L/C at sight.
lines.cn: 我们接受电汇和即期信用证。这个20万美金的项目，即期信用证可以。我们要求30%定金或100%即期信用证。

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: We prefer 100 percent L/C at sight.

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: That is acceptable. We will include the warranty and penalty clauses in the contract. The 2-year warranty covers manufacturing defects.
lines.cn: 可以。我们会在合同里写质保和违约条款。2年质保涵盖生产缺陷。

fillBlank.q: We require a 30 percent ____ to start production.
The balance is paid against ____ copy.

scenario.q: A client asks about payment terms for a USD 200,000 project. How do you respond?
scenario.modelAnswer: For this 200,000 USD project, we accept either 30 percent T/T deposit with 70 percent balance against B/L copy, or 100 percent L/C at sight. We provide a 2-year warranty covering manufacturing defects, and a penalty clause for late delivery. Which option do you prefer?
scenario.cn: 这个20万美金项目，我们接受：30%电汇定金+70%见提单副本尾款，或100%即期信用证。我们提供2年质保涵盖生产缺陷，并有延迟交货违约条款。您偏好哪种？

culture.title: 付款方式的风险
culture.content: T/T 30/70是教玩具外贸最常见条款。风险点：100%前T/T对客户风险大，100%后T/T对供应商风险大。新客户建议至少30%定金，老客户可谈10/90或5%质保金。
